extraction.Name: Robert Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 15, 1918, by O. F. Benson
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Henry J. Abrahams for $1000; on January 20, 1920, Emery conveyed the land by deed to the First State Bank of Wood for $1.00 and other things considered, subject to the $1000 mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612715 issued; Southeast quarter section 16, township 38, range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee but not dated; mortgage dated June 6, 1918, signed by Emery to Henry J. Abrahams for $1000, is of record
